Name: Hengst Filtration | Industrial Air Filtration
Description:
Hengst is recognized as one of the market leaders in filtration to automotive and engines industry, as a producer of a wide variety of filtration applications in the industrial and consumer goods sectors. With more than 3,000 employees at 14 locations on four continents, the Hengst family of companies is well-established globally.

We provide high technology air filtration solutions for air inlet houses and dust collectors in all parts of the world. We supply air filtration solutions for all operating environments and all applications.
 
Our filter cartridges are installed on GE, Siemens, Alstom, Turbomach, Solar and many other gas turbines around the world and we provide air filtration solutions to most dust collectors and baghouses. 

With our vast filtration experience and our wide range of high quality filter media and material, we offer:
- custom solutions for specific filtration needs
- replacement filter elements
- on-site technical field support
- filter analysis to establish residual filter life
- filter house inspection and maintenance programs

Our R&D departments and manufacturing sites situated in Denmark and the Middle East work closely together to ensure our global customers certified high quality products. All filters are produced in Denmark or in the Middle East by skilled workers and in everything we do, we strive to continuously develop innovative filtration solutions that increase performance and reduce Total Cost of Ownership for our global customers.

Name: Tjæreborg Industri
Description:
Tjæreborg Industri er en familiejet virksomhed, der i dag ledes af direktør Marianne Sørensen, som er 4. generation og oldebarn af Peder Christian Pedersen, som grundlagde virksomheden helt tilbage i 1881 som en lille traditionel landsbysmedje.

Siden har den familieejede virksomhed udviklet sig til at være en international og dynamisk virksomhed med godt 150 medarbejdere, og virksomhedens 5. generation er ligeledes sikret, idet Marianne Sørensens to børn, Anders Sørensen og Sandra Sørensen allerede i dag er med i virksomhedens ledelse og ejerkreds.

Tjæreborg Industri beskæftiger sig med en bred vifte af arbejdsområder, primært indenfor fjernvarme, el, energi og stålkonstruktioner.

Et højt kvalitets- og serviceniveau har altid været virksomhedens kendetegn, og firmaet har i dag en stor fast kreds af kunder og leverandører, som man har samarbejdet med i mange år.

Tjæreborg Industri hører til blandt landets førende indenfor sine virkefelter. De erfarne og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere besidder stor know-how og ekspertise, hvilket vil være medvirkende til, at Tjæreborg Industri også i fremtiden kan fastholde og videreudvikle sin position i markedet.

Foruden Tjæreborg Industri omfatter den familieejede virksomhed også datterselskabet Tjæreborg Kompensatorfabrik i daglig tale kaldet TComp, som designer og producerer stålkompensatorer.

Name: WATERCryst ApS
Description:
WATERCryst er en tysk-østrigsk virksomhed, der udvikler og producerer BIOCAT kalkbeskyttelsesanlæg til professionelle installationer i hele Europa. 

En af vores styrker er, at vi har vores egen, patenterede katalysatorteknologi og fuld kontrol over produktionen på egne fabrikker. 

Det betyder høj kvalitet, stabil drift og en løsning, der beskytter installationer mod kalk helt uden brug af salt og kemikalier. Resultatet er lavere driftsomkostninger, minimalt vedligehold og en markant forbedret energieffektivitet – samtidig med, at miljøet skånes. 

BIOCAT-anlæggene forlænger levetiden på varmevekslere, kedler og rørsystemer og reducerer risikoen for driftsstop. Det gør anlæggene særligt attraktive for ejendomme, hvor driftssikkerhed og økonomi går hånd i hånd. 

Vi har i dag mange tusinde anlæg i drift i Europa, herunder markante referenceinstallationer som f.eks. Allianz Arena i München. 

I Danmark har vi kontor på Gl. Kongevej i København og arbejder primært med større anlæg til boligforeninger og professionelle ejendomsejere. Anlæggene blev introduceret på det danske marked i 2022, og vi er nu i gang med at opbygge en stærk, langsigtet position. 

Kort sagt: 
WATERCryst gør kalkbeskyttelse mere effektiv, mere økonomisk og mere miljøvenlig – uden kemi, uden salt og uden kompromiser, når det gælder driftssikkerheden.

Name: Viochar
Description:
Viochar is a Danish company that manufactures pyrolysis reactors for biochar production.

We build batch pyrolysis systems—equipment designed to process organic feedstocks in individual runs rather than continuous flow. Batch systems offer simpler operation and maintenance compared to continuous alternatives, making them suitable for smaller-scale producers and operations processing variable feedstock types.

Our reactors handle a range of organic inputs including agricultural residues, wood chips, and green waste. The biochar produced meets quality standards for agricultural use and carbon credit certification.

We design our equipment for farmers, agricultural enterprises, waste management operations, and organisations producing carbon removal credits. Some will use biochar to improve soil health on their own land. Others will sell it as a product or generate revenue through certified carbon credits. The same equipment supports all of these paths.

We are based in Europe and sell equipment worldwide.

Name: BÆTA Carbon
Description:
Our innovation addresses two critical environmental challenges - carbon emissions and plastic pollution - by converting everyday plastic waste into truly scalable technology against climate change.

Each year, over 80 million tonnes of PET are produced - that's a fifth of all plastics - with 85-90% ending up in landfills or incinerated. Our innovative approach upcycles PET waste in its multiple forms, including food packaging, colored PET, and low-quality polyester-based textiles, into high-performance materials for CO2 capture. To capture it briefly, we grant plastic an alternative second life as a carbon sponge. 

Supported by the Novo Nordisk Foundation CO2 Research Center (CORC) and the KU Lighthouse, our project is being developed in the Department of Chemistry at the University of Copenhagen, under the leadership of Jiwoong Lee.

We are actively seeking industrial partners to advance technology development and enable knowledge exchange. 

Join us in driving sustainable innovation at the intersection of waste recycling and climate change mitigation. Together, we can create impactful solutions for a circular and sustainable future.

Name: ZikaSeal Aps
Description:
About
ZikaSealTM is a spin-out from the University of Copenhagen dedicated to protecting public health through sustainable, pesticide-free mosquito control.

Our patented barrier system prevents the Asian tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus) from breeding in urban storm drains – one of its main habitats in European cities. This mosquito is spreading rapidly northwards due to climate change and is a proven vector of dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and West Nile virus.

Unlike conventional control methods that rely on repeated pesticide applications, ZikaSealTM offers a maintenance-free, climate-adapted solution:
	•	Patented technology with 99% blocking effect (tested at EID Méditerranée, France).
	•	Field-validated with pilots in Monaco and Copenhagen.
	•	Pesticide-free and environmentally safe, eliminating chemical pollution.
	•	Climate-resilient, designed to withstand heavy rainfall and future weather extremes.

We combine our barrier with real-time hotspot modeling using satellite, climate, and entomological data, enabling cities and resorts to prioritize interventions where the risk is highest.

Customers
	•	European cities with >20,000 inhabitants (standard order: 10,000 drains).
	•	Resorts, hotels, amusement parks, and camping sites (standard order: 200 drains).

Market potential
	•	12.9 million storm drains across 13 EU countries.
	•	6,600+ global resorts and leisure facilities in the tiger mosquito belt.

Vision
To become the go-to company for reducing mosquito-borne diseases by offering an integrated hardware and software solution that protects citizens, tourists, and biodiversity.

Name: Redoxa
Description:
We are a pre-startup developing systems that restore and stabilize healthy marine ecosystems.

Eelgrass (like grass on land but underwater) used to cover an area 10x larger than its current extent in Danish waters. With its removal, we lost its ecosystem services:

• habitat for commercially important fish 
• high carbon uptake and storage
• coastal protection / sediment stabilization 

Immediate - efficient and scalable - efforts are urgently needed to bring back much of its historic extent (concurrent with improvements in water quality).

We plant eelgrass using metal grids that both provide a scalable, module-based framework but moreover - through a wire and rolled up grid in the surface - connects the (often oxygen free) sediments with oxygen in the surface waters. 

This protects the restoration  against low-oxygen events and further reduces the release of methane (20-80 CO2e) and H2S (highly toxic). 

Its a simple solution and a simple construction with a wide range of environments, including harbours, aquaculture, sheltered waters and data centre reservoirs. 

After two years, out system will be removed, leaving behind a restored, healthy habitat.

We are currently deploying prototypes to gain a deeper insight into the systems’ functioning for further optimization. 

Please reach out if you want to get involved - as a student (all Universities), potential co-founder or learn more as an angel/seed investor.

Name: Meltem Ventilation Danmark
Description:

Vores mål er at sikre et optimalt indeklima for vores kunder med fokus på komfort, sundhed og energieffektivitet.
